metadata.source: original saved six-point angular-rate trajectories and unchanged weights
metadata.operation: weighted mean and centered full covariance, with both sides of every acquisition retained
metadata.angular_rate_update: fresh independent Gaussian centered at the acquired gyro with covariance sigma^2 I; not Bayesian conditioning of prior rate
metadata.linear_forced_covariance: constant sigma^2 I between acquisitions because its angular-rate sensitivity is identity
metadata.nonlinear_covariance: nonlinear dynamics can increase or decrease different marginal widths; a new observation need not narrow every axis
